### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ooutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

+outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ooutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

houtflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

noutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

toutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

aoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

coutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

boutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

boutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

moutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

doutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

houtflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

noutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

.outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

houtflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

toutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

coutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

foutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

`outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the

the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ooutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

routflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

#outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

noutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ioutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

coutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

moutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

routflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the

the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

noutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

`outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

zoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

-outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

5outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

routflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).


outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.
