Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

voutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ioutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ooutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ooutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ioutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

toutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

`outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

```bash

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

houtflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

aoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

toutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

uoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

2outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

.outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

coutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

Toutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash

```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

 outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

coutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

goutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

loutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).


outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the

the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

Poutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

poutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

aoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the key named:

```bash

centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ioutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

Toutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

eoutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

`outflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,

removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

soutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

### Prepare the case file

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

ooutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.

Every run reads a case file (`[case] file`, default `<field_prefix>.case.h5`),
the single source of truth for grid, block layout, leaf table and IBM
coefficients, written by `moby_prepare` from the SAME ini (prepare/solve split,
`docs/prepare_solve_strategy.md`). The body is classified against the solver's
exact grid there; `moby_solve` never builds one and refuses a stale one with
the key named:

```bash
cd tutorials/sailplane
mpirun -n 2 ../../build_cpu/moby_prepare input.ini      # -> sailplane_case.h5, minutes on 2 ranks
```

`stl_scale = 0.001` converts the STL from millimetres to metres; `stl_translate`
centres the mirrored STL in the full domain (the solver then uses only the
positive-`y` half). **Re-run `moby_prepare` whenever the grid, the block layout,
the STL transform or `re` changes** (the solver tells you which key moved).
The old single-level `sailplane_ibm_coeff.h5` of the retired mobygeom was
removed with its reader at step 7-4 (git history).

boutflow; the $y$ and $z$ faces are symmetry/far-field. `[ibm]` declares the STL
geometry; the coefficients the solver reads live in the CASE FILE.
